## Site-Response Spectra {#sec-site_results}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/UHS.qmd",
    stem = "site-uhs",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(CAP = readCaption("fig.UHS"), CAP.MCE = readCaption("fig.UHS.MCE"), ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    anchor = "sec-site-uhs-site",
    context = "site UHS"
  )
}
rm(i)
```
